title: NOAA Weather-Satellite Pass Capture Log
dataSources: APRS packets (`aprs:packet`), WSPR spots (`wspr:spot`), satellite passes (`satpass:prediction`), NOAA APT captures (`noaa:apt`), meteor-scatter pings (`meteorscatter:ping`), SSTV images (`sstv:image`).
app: Software-defined radio and ham-radio stations — APRS igate, WSPR beacon, NOAA weather-satellite (APT) receiver, meteor-scatter monitor, and SSTV decoder — logging to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=noaa:apt
| stats count as captures, avg(max_elevation) as avg_elev, sum(eval(if(quality="good",1,0))) as good by satellite
| eval success_pct=round(100*good/captures,1)
| sort - captures
description: Logs each weather-satellite image capture and how many came out clean, so you can tune your antenna and timing.
value: APT reception is finicky; tracking capture success per satellite tells you whether an antenna change actually improved your images.
implementation: Ingest capture metadata from your NOAA APT receiver; schedule daily and review success rate per satellite.
visualization: Bar chart of capture success rate by satellite.
grandmaExplanation: It records each time you catch a picture from a weather satellite and how many turned out clear.
